subject_knowledge_policy: Existing knowledge only; no browsing, external search, other files, or delegation. Tools only for the required opaque prompt-file read and raw response-file write/hash.
common_prefix: Answer the research request below using your existing knowledge only. Do not browse, search external sources, inspect other files, or delegate. Do not invent references; clearly mark any source name or factual claim you are unsure about.
common_request: Recommend an evaluation plan for this research request. Give (1) benchmark(s) or datasets and metric(s), (2) the specific claim and decision they support, (3) material limitations or missing evidence and whether the plan is sufficient, and (4) confidence and what would change your recommendation. Identify primary sources if you know them; a source name is acceptable when you do not recall a reliable URL. Aim for 180–240 words and do not exceed 300 words.

conditions.baseline: Before answering, organize your response around the requested outputs. Use clear paragraphs and concrete recommendations, keep related points together, and distinguish your final recommendation from any brief optional context you include for the researcher.
conditions.structured: Before answering, check the research claim, task, target population, data distribution, metric, and inference from scores to conclusions. Then assess whether the proposed evaluation supports the intended decision or requires qualifications or additional evidence.

launch_template: Read only {prompt_path}. It contains the complete research request. Use tools only to read that file and write your final answer verbatim to {response_path}, including computing its SHA-256. Do not inspect other files, browse, search external sources, or delegate. Answer from existing knowledge. After writing, return only the response path and SHA-256; do not repeat the answer in your final message.
interface_notes: The parent must record exact prompt text, opaque paths, launch message, file hash and completion status for every trial.
Model/configuration is inherited from the parent; record session-reported identity without inventing an API snapshot.
Opaque file delivery is an agent read/write interface, not a stateless API or tool-free conversation.
Platform system/developer instructions still apply; fork_turns=none withholds parent task history.
Source-reference requests do not mean that the subject retrieved or verified those sources.
Word-matched additions can still differ in token count, focus and semantics.
